title: [review] lichen-oscore hygiene: gate sha2 behind edhoc, vectors.rs slice guard, RFC number typo, zeroization doc claim
description: P3 bundle, rust/lichen-oscore: (1) Cargo.toml:22 sha2 is unconditional but only used under edhoc feature -> optional = true + edhoc = ["dep:sha2", ...]; (2) tests/vectors.rs:790-793 msg2[2..34] can panic OOB on a truncated fixture before the g_y_len assert reads claimed length -> add msg2.len() >= 34 assert first; (3) transcript.rs:46,49 + test name say RFC 9529 where the transcript construction is RFC 9528 (9529 is the signature trace doc) -> correct; (4) lib.rs:189 doc claims dropping previous Context zeroizes key material — property lives in upstream oscore crate, verify or soften the claim.
